snippet.title: MICHAEL JACKSON BILLIE JEAN VICTORY TOUR LIVE 4K REMASTERED
snippet.description:
The Victory Tour, performed by The Jacksons (including Michael Jackson), had several dates in Canada. The most notable dates were in Montreal, Toronto, and Vancouver in the fall of 1984. In Toronto, they played at the Exhibition Stadium on October 5th, 1984, and had a three-night run there. 
The tour was a major event, with one promoter calling it "the largest-attended set of concerts in the history of Canada". The sound system and stage, including a seven-story video screen, were massive, requiring 375 tonnes of equipment and three days to set up. The tour also faced some initial challenges, with Toronto being initially left off the itinerary due to a lack of venues. However, public outcry led to the addition of the three-night stop in Toronto.
